content.title: Taylor Frankie Paul Kids: Meet Indy, Ocean and Ever
content.text: Actualizado 19/03/2026 - 18:57 CDTDespite the controversies that have surrounded her public life, Taylor Frankie Paul has made one thing clear: her children come first. The reality star of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives is a mother of three -Indy, Ocean and Ever- who remain at the center of her world.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoHow many kids does Taylor Frankie Paul have?Taylor has three children from two relationships. She shares her two oldest kids with her ex-husband Tate Paul, and her youngest with her ex-partner Dakota Mortensen.Her journey through motherhood has unfolded alongside her rise to fame, from TikTok influencer to reality TV personality."I don't know how I got so lucky to be your mommy," she wrote alongside a series of photos in IG. "He is the sweetest soul and loves love. Needy like his daddy and stubborn like his mommy. Just as hyper as his sister and brother. Couldn't be more loved by his village he has beside him.Indy May PaulTaylor's first child, Indy May, was born on August 31, 2017, less than a year after she married Tate Paul. Indy is often described by Taylor as both sweet and full of personality.Over the years, Indy has frequently appeared in her mother's social media content, from holiday moments to everyday milestones. Taylor has also shared that her daughter is bright, expressive and a loving older sister.Ocean PaulIn June 2020, Taylor and Tate welcomed their second child, a son named Ocean. His arrival came as Taylor's online presence was rapidly growing, and she documented parts of her pregnancy and early motherhood journey with her followers.Ocean is known within the family as a playful and affectionate child. Despite the later separation between Taylor and Tate, both have continued to co-parent their children and maintain a cooperative relationship focused on their well-being.Ever True MortensenTaylor's youngest child, Ever True, was born on March 19, 2024, during her relationship with Dakota Mortensen. His birth marked a new chapter in her life following her divorce.Taylor has described Ever as loving and energetic, and his name carries a personal meaning tied to strength and continuity. Although she and Dakota later separated, both parents have remained involved in Ever's life and continue to co-parent.Motherhood amid controversyTaylor's life as a mother has also been shaped by personal challenges. In 2023, she faced legal issues related to a domestic incident, later pleading guilty to aggravated assault while other charges were dismissed.In March 2026, ABC scrapped The Secret Lives of Mormon Wive" star's already filmed season of The Bachelorette just three days before it was scheduled to premiere on Sunday. The decision came about on Thursday after TMZ published a 2023 video of Paul throwing three metal barstools at her then-boyfriend, Mortensen. One of the chairs inadvertently hit her daughter.
